s: Bammeh behema yotzet beshabbat ubo l"ch seipim kebar nitbaer besimman rm"v sheadam metzuvveh al shebitat behemto min hattora, veim behemto hotzia ezeh dabar lirshut harabbim ap sheyyatzat meeleha — abar hu al mitzvat aseh shel tora. Ella sheyyesh miqtzat debarim shedderek habbehema latzet bahem bechol ap kesheenah noset massoy, udebarim ellu chashubim lah takshit, umuttar shettetze bahem lirshut harabbim beshabbat. Veellu hem: kol dabar shehabbehema mishtammeret al yado shello tibrach kesheholeket birshut harabbim, kegon resen vekayyotze bo, kemo sheyyitbaer, vei epshar leshomrah bishmira pechuta mizzo harbeh. Veap sheepshar leshomrah bishmira pechuta mizzo meat — muttar shettetze bishmira zo lirshut harabbim, lepi shekken darkah bechol latzet ap bishmira zo, veap shehi yetera lah qetzat, shehare ap bipchuta mizzo day lah, mikkol maqom en derek haolam lekavven hashshemira uletzamtzemah, im ken ap shemira zo shehi yetera qetzat — hi takshit lah, kevan sheddarkah latzet kak bechol peamim rabbot ap kesheenah noset massoy. Abal im day lah bishmira pechuta mizzo harbeh, shennimtzet shemira zo yetera harbeh — hare hi massoy lah, mippene sheen darkah bechol latzet bishmira yetera harbeh. Veen tzarik lomar shello tetze bekol dabar sheenah nishmeret bo, ap al pi sheoto dabar day lishmor bo behema acheret, kevan sheeno day lishmor bo behema zo — en derek behema zo leolam latzet bedabar zeh, vahare hu lah massoy gamur:

Lepikak, hannaqa, vehi gamla neqeba gedola ulebana, yotzet bachatam, vehu tabbaat shel barzel shennoqebin chotmah umaknisin lah hattabbaat, abal enah yotzet beapsar, shekkevan sheenah nishmeret bo — hare hu massoy lah. Vehallubeddqim, vehu chamor habba min lub, veken hassus shellanu — yotzeim ben beapsar (perush qebishetr"u), ben biprumbeya (perush peri"g), vehu resen shel barzel. Veap shehaapsar day lahem — en happerumbeya lahem shemira yetera harbeh ella yetera qetzat, vedarkam bekak peamim rabbot. Umikkol maqom, lo yetzeu bishnehem yachad, beapsar ubiprumbeya, ella beachat mehen. Abal happered vehaggamal vehachamor yotzein beapsar abal lo biprumbeya, mippene shehapperumbeya lahem shemira yetera harbeh, veen darkam bekak (abal hashshor lo yetze beapsar, kemo sheyyitbaer):

Vekol behema hayyotzet beapsar — en tzarik lemoshkah beapsar, ella muttar likrok chebel haapsar sebib tzavvarah lenoy vetetze bo, shennoy zeh darkah hu, shekken regilut bechol likrok haapsar lenoy. Bammeh debarim amurim? Benoy kazeh vekayyotze bo shehu ragil bakkol, abal noy sheen regilin bo ella miqtzat anashim — lo tetze bo, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veyesh omerim sheapillu noy haragil bakkol — asur shettetze bo, sheen noy libhema, velo hittiru likrok chebel haapsar sebib tzavvarah ella beripyon qetzat, sheyyukal lehaknis yado bimhera ben hakkerika letzavvarah kede lemoshkah keshettirtzeh lehishshamet mimmennu, shebbeinyan zeh hu regilut latzet bechol. (Uleinyan halaka, birshut harabbim — yesh lehachamir kisbara haacharona. Abal bekarmelit shehi middibre soperim — yesh lehaqel kisbara harishona). (Veap al pi ken, kevan shehu dabar sheen bo tzorek kelal — tob lehachamir bekol maqom kisbara haacharona):

Muttar letaltel haapsar o haresen velitteno al habbehema hayyotzea bo, veen bo mishshum issur tiltul, mippene shemmukan hu libhema, ubilbad shello yishshaen al roshah o gupah keshennoteno aleha, kemo sheyyitbaer:
Im qashar chebel bepi hassus — hare zeh massoy, lepi sheeno mishtammer bo, shehu nishmat mippiv, veeno domeh leapsar shehu qashur berosho:

Kol behema sheasaqeha raim — muttar shettetze bishmira yetera. Veap al pi sheen benot minah tzerikot leotah shemira umassoy hu lahen — enah massoy lah, kevan shehi tzerika lekak vedarkah bekak bechol. Umuttar shettetze apillu bb' mine shemirot, kegon apsar veresen yachad, im hi tzerika lekak, vehakkol lepi hainyan:

Baale hashsher, kegon kelabim shel tzayyadim vechayyot qetannot sheyyesh lahem kemin etzada sebib tzavvarah vetabbaat qabua bah umaknisin retzua battabbaat umoshekin otah bah — muttar sheyyetzeu besher zeh lirshut harabbim. Veyakol lemoshkan bo kedarko bechol. Umuttar gam ken likrok haretzua sebib tzavvaran, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Elim yotzeim lebubim, vehu or sheqqosherim lahem tachat zakrutam, kede shello yaalu al hanneqebot, mippene sheddarkam latzet kak bechol, vahare zeh kemalbush lahem. Veharechelot yotzeot shechuzot, vehu sheqqosherin alyatan kelappe mala al gabban, kede sheyyaalu alehen hazzekarim. Veyotzeot kebulot, vehu sheqqosherin alyatan kebulot lematta, kede shello yaalu alehen hazzekarim. Veyotzeot kebunot, vehu sheqqosherin beged sebiban lishmor hatztzemer sheyyihyeh naqi. Vehaizzim yotzeot tzerurot, vehu sheqqosherin matlit al rashe daddehen. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheqqosheram sham kede sheyyitztammequ daddehen velo yechalebu, sheaz derek lihyot haqqesher mehuddaq yapeh. Abal im qesharam sham kede lishmor chalabam bedaddehen shello yetaptep mehen laaretz, sheaz en derek lehaqpid sheyyihyeh mehuddaq yapeh — asur lehannichan latzet kak beshabbat, gezera shemma tippol hammatlit meal daddehen veyishkach vibienna beyado lebeto:

Hachamor darko latzet bemardaat ap kesheeno nose massoy, mippene shetteba hachamor hu qar, vaapillu bitqupat tammuz qar lo, velaken notenin alayv mardaat lechammemo, veim qashar lo hammardaat meereb shabbat — muttar sheyyetze bah beshabbat, shemmalbusho hi. Abal im enah qeshura lo — lo yetze bah, gezera shemma tippol mealayv vibienna beyado. Ubeshabbat i epshar leqoshrah lo, mippene shekkesheqqosher tzarik lehitqareb elayv velishshaen alayv qetzat, venimtza mishtammesh bebaale chayyim, vezeh asur, mittaam sheyyitbaer:

Abal lo yetze hachamor beukkap ap al pi sheqqashur lo meereb shabbat, mippene sheen haukkap mechammem oto, veen darko latzet bo ella im ken nose massoy. Ushear kol habbehemot ap bemardaat lo yetzeu, mippene sheen darkan bekak ella im ken noseot massoy, lepi sheenan tzerikot lehitchammem kemo hachamor:

Muttar litten mardaat al hachamor bechatzer mippene hatztzinna, ubilbad shello yetze bah, kevan sheasur leqoshrah lo. Abal al hassus ushear habbehemot — asur litten mardaat kalal apillu bechatzer, mippene shennireh keillu rotzeh lehatino massoy, vegam hu torach shello letzorek, kevan sheen lo tzaar mehatztzinna. Veap sheyyesh lo taanug mechimmum hammardaat — lo hittiru litroach beshabbat bishbil taanug habbehema ella bishbil tzaarah, kemo hachamor sheyyesh lo tzaar mitztzinna apillu bitqupat tammuz, ubeshaa shehaqqor gadol, veanu roim sheyyesh tzaar lehassus. Veken bimot hachamma im hazzebubim rabbim umetzaarim lehassus — dino kachamor, umuttar lehanniach alayv mardaat. Abal asur lehanniach ukkap al gabbe hachamor, kevan sheeno mechammemo, veen tzarik lomar al gabbe sus ushear behemot, sheenan tzerikot chimmum kelal. Ubehema shehaya aleha ukkap o mardaat — asur lahasiran mealeha, ben shehi chamor o sus o mishshear behemot, mippene shezzehu torach shello letzorek. Vaapillu ukkap sheal gabbe chamor shebba min hadderek venityaggea vetzarik lahasiro mealayv letzanneno — lo yittelennu mealayv beyado, sheap sheyyesh lo qetzat tzaar mechimmum hammassoy shel haukkap, mikkol maqom meelayv yitztannen kesheyyanuach, shehachamor tibo qar, sheap bitqupat tammuz qar lo, ella im hu rotzeh letzanneno miyyad — mattir mittachtayv et hachebel shehaukkap qashur bo, umolik umebi et hachamor bechatzer ad sheyyippol haukkap meelayv:

En tolin lachamor terasqal, vehu sal male seorim shettolin libhema betzavvarah, venoten piha letoko veokelet, vetaanug beolma hu, shello titztarek lashuach tzavvarah laaretz, veasur litroach beshabbat bishbil taanug habbehema. Abal agalim useyachim shetztzavvaran qatzer umitztaarim lashuach leekol meal gabbe qarqa — muttar litlot lahen terasqal betzavvaran bechatzer, abal lo yetzeu bo, shemmassoy hu lahen:

Lo yetze hassus biznab shual shettolin ben enayv shello tishlot bo ayin hara, velo bizhorit shebben enayv sheosim lo lenoy, shennoy zeh eno ragil bakkol, ella miqtzat anashim osim ken. Velo yetzeu izzim bekis shebbedaddehen, sheqqosherim oto kede shello yesaretu daddehen beqotzim shehayu daddehen gassim, gezera shemma yippol hakkis vibiennu beyado, sheen derek liqshor yapeh kis zeh beqesher mehuddaq. Velo tetze para bachasom shebbepiha, shechosemin piha shello tireh bisdot acherim, shekkevan sheeno shemirat gupah — hare zeh massoy. Velo tetze kol behema besandal shennoalim beragleha shello tinnagep, gezera shemma yippol meragleha vibiennu beyado. Abal yotzet beeged sheal gabbe hammakka ubeqasqassim sheal gabbe hashsheber, vehem shene luchot sheqqosherim sebib etzem hannishbar shello yanud aneh vaana ad sheyyitchabber, veyotzet beshilya hamduldelet bah sheyyotzta miqtzatah uteluya bah:

Zug hattaluy betzavvar behema, o kelabim vachatulim veopot im poqeqo betzemer o bemokin, shello yeqashqesh hainbal betoko, velo yashmia qol shel shir kederek hazzugin — muttar shettetayyel bezug zeh bechatzer. Abal lo tetze bo lirshut harabbim, apillu hi ir hamorebet, ben im hu betzavvarah ben im hu arug biksutah (perush kegon susim meullim shemmekassim otam biksut kede shello yittanepu veen kesut zo chashuba massoy, kevan sheddarkam bekak, ukemo shennitbaer lemala birchelot hakkebunot), mippene marit haayin, shennireh keillu molikah lashshuq limkor, sheaz hu derek litlot lehazzug lenaotah bipne haqqonim, abal bechatzer en sham roim sheyyachsheduhu. Veap shekkol dabar sheaseru chakamim mippene marit haayin aseru apillu bechadre chadarim, mikkol maqom kan sheap im yaaseh ken bimqom roim lo yachsheduhu beissur shel tora ella beissur miqqach umimkar shehu middibre soperim — lo hechemiru kol kak leesor ap bemaqom sheen roim. Veken haddin bekol kayyotze bazeh. (Chaser kan. Ayyen magen abraham veeliyya zuta umordekay vedarke mosheh, vetzarik iyyun beseper hatteruma):
Lo tetze behema bechotam, ben shehu betzavvarah ben shehu biksuta, gezera shemma yippaseq veyippol vibiennu beyado, vaapillu hu arug biksutah, shello chillequ chakamim:

Lo yetze haggamal bimtultelet, vehu kemo kar qatan male mokin shennotenin tachat zenabo shello tashchit haretzua et habbasar, gezera shemma yippol mealayv vibiennu beyado. Vaapillu im hu qashur lo biznabo — chosheshim shemma yishshamet veyippol, ella im ken qashur lo biznabo ubachatotarto, shekkevan sheqqashur bishnehem — en lachush sheyyippol. Veken im qashur beshilyatah — yotzea bo, shebbevadday lo tenattechennu sheyyippol mealeha, mippene sheyyikab lah im tenattechennu:

Lo yetze haggamal aqud velo ragul, veken shear kol habbehemot. Veezehu aqud? Sheqqosher yado achat im raglo veragul shekkopep raglo achat lemala veqosherah sham, kede shello yelek ella al g' raglayim, shello yukal libroach (gezera shemma yippol hachebel meal raglayv vibiennu beyado):

Lo yiqshor gemallim zeh bezeh vehu topes beyado apsar harishon vekullam nimshakim al yado, vaapillu enan ella shenayim, vaapillu hayu qeshurim zeh bezeh meereb shabbat — lo yimshekem ken beshabbat apillu hi ir hamorebet, mippene shennireh keillu molikem lashshuq limkor. Abal im topes kamma apsare gemallim beyado — muttar, veken shear kol habbehemot (veayyen beyoreh dea simman rtz"z):

Hammotzi behema umoshekah bechebel haapsar — tzarik lizzaher shello yetze rosh hachebel mittachat yado tepach lematta, mippene sheddomeh kemo shennose chebel tepach zeh beyado veeno nireh shehu mehaapsar sheal habbehema. Umikkol maqom, im hotzi tepach echad mittachat yado — lo asa issur, ella im ken hotzi b' tepachim. Ella shelleinyan maaseh tzarik lehachamir shello yetze apillu tepach echad miyyado. Vetzarik shehachebel shebben yado labbehema yihyeh gaboah min haaretz tepach o yoter, dehaynu sheyyizzaher shello lehanniach harbeh min hachebel ben yado labbehema, kede shello yakbid kol kak beemtzao ad sheyyaggia betepach hassamuk laaretz kede shettehe niret habbehema nimsheket bo, sheim lo ken en nireh sheochez rosh haapsar beyado ella chebel acher. Veim hachebel arok harbeh — yikrok oto sebib tzavvarah, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Lo yetze hachamor besullam shebbetzavvaro, vehem luchot sheqqosherim sebib tzavvaro shello yukal lechakkek makkato beshinnayv, veluchot ellu chashubim yoter miqqasqassim sheal gabbe hashsheber, veim yippelu mealayv yachus alehem vibiem beyado, laken lo yetze bahem. Veken lo yetze birtzua shebberaglo, vehu kemin tabbaat aba sheosim miqqash veqosherim beragle habbehema sheppesioteha qetzarot umakka ragleha zo bezo, veosim lah zeh lehagen shello takkeh zo bezo. Veen hattarnegolim yotzeim bechutin sheqqosherim beraglehem shello yitchallepu baacherim, velo birtzua qetzara sheqqosherim bah shette raglehem yachad kede shello yukelu leharim raglehem lehattiz shello yeshabberu et hakkelim, veen haelim yotzeim baagala qetanna shettachat alyotehem, sheosim lahem ken shello tilqeh haalya bislaim uterashim keshettehe nigreret baaretz, veen haizzim yotzeim beetz yadua shennotenim bechotmehen kede sheyyitatteshu veyippelu hattolaim shebberashehen, shebbekol ellu yesh lachush shemma yippelu vibiem beyado. Velo yetze haegel beol qatan shennotenim al tzavvaro sheyyehe lamud lakop rosho liksheyyigdal, velo bizmam shemmannichim bepiv shel egel kede shello yinaq mehappara keshehi bemireh (shekkevan sheeno lishmirat gupo — massoy hu lo). Velo tetze para beor sheretz shennimayv chaddin kemachat, veqosherim oro bedadde habbehema shello yinequha sheratzim. Velo birtzua sheqqosherim lah ben qarneha, ben sheqqesharah leshimmur, dehaynu leochozah ulemoshkah bah keshettirtzeh libroach, ben shetztzebaah uqesharah lah lenoy, mippene shennoy zeh eno ragil bakkol, vahare hu massoy, veshimmur en happara tzerika kelal, sheen darkah libroach. Veken haddin beshor. Velaken lo yetzeu shor upara bechebel shebbetzavvaram, shemmassoy hu lahem, abal agalim muttar, mippene shehem moredim beqal utzerikim shemira, vedarkam latzet beapsar lipamim:

Habbehema yotzea beqamea shehu mumcheh, abal lo beqamea shello nitmacheh adayin libhema ap al pi shennitmacheh leadam, mippene shehaadam yesh lo mazzal umalak hammelitz alayv lemala, umazzalo mesayyea lo sheyyoil lo haqqamea hazzeh, mah sheen ken libhema:

Kol dabar sheasur shettetze bo habbehema lirshut harabbim mippene shehu massoy lah — asur shettetze bo lekarmelit middibre soperim ledibre hakkol, ap shehi hotzaa shello kedarkah, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"g bitziat haishsha. Vekol dabar shehu takshit lah lepi sheddarkah latzet bo bechol ella sheasur shettetze bo beshabbat middibre soperim mishshum gezera shemma yippol vibiennu — muttar shettetze bo lekarmelit lehammattirin ken betakshite adam kemo shennitbaer sham, abal lehaoserim sham hu haddin sheasur gabbe behema, ukebar nitbaer sham shekkol adam yesh lo lehachamir leatzmo kedibre haoserim. Abal ledibre hakkol muttar shettetze habbehema bechatzer (apillu bedabar sheasur shettetze bo min hattora), sheap sheyyesh oserim beadam ap bechatzer mishshum gezera shemma yishkach veyetze bo lirshut harabbim kemo shennitbaer sham, mikkol maqom bibhemto lo hechemiru ligzor kol kak ledibre hakkol:

En rokebim al gabbe behema, velo nitlim aleha, velo nishanim aleha, sheen mishtammeshin bebaale chayyim kol iqqar, shekkalelu chakamim kol shimmush bebaale chayyim biklal gezerat harekiba, sheggazeru aleha mishshum shemma yabo lachtok zemora meilan hammechubbar kede lehanhig bah habbehema sherokeb aleha. Vaapillu betzidde habbehema asur lehishtammesh, kegon leshapshep hattinoq betzidde gabbah kede leshasheo, veken lehissamek letziddah. Abal tzidde tzedadin, kegon sheddabar acher munnach al tzidde gabbah o al shear tzedadeha vehu mishtammesh betzidde oto dabar — hare zeh muttar. Abal asur lehishtammesh al gabbe oto dabar hammunnach al tziddah, mippene shehu kemishtammesh al tziddah mammash. Lepikak, qaron shehabbehema molika oto betok hattechum ap al pi shennokri manhig habbehema — asur likkanes laqqaron, mippene sheyyedot haqqaron hen al tzidde habbehema, vehayyadot im gup haqqaron hakkol dabar echad, vehanniknas laqqaron — hare zeh mishtammesh bedabar hammunnach al tzidde habbehema, velo hittiru ella lehishtammesh betzidde oto dabar. Vegam al haddap hayyotze meachore haqqaron asur lesheb, mippene shehaqqaron im kol hammechubbar bo veyotze mimmennu hakkol nechshab ledabar echad, veasur lehishtammesh al gabbeha ella betziddehem. Abal sepina shemmolikot otah behemot haholekot bispat hannahar — muttar lelek bah beshabbat, shekkevan shehabbehemot holekot rachoq mimmenna — hare hu tzidde tzedadim. Vegam en lachush beholek bispina shemma yachtok zemora lehanhig habbehemot kemo sheyyesh lachush beyosheb beqaron, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"ch:

Mi sheala al gabbe behema beshabbat, apillu ala bemezid shehaya rauy leqonso sheyyesheb aleha kol hashshabbat velo yered mimmenna ad laereb kemo sheqqanesu beoleh al gabbe ilan beshabbat — ap al pi ken mishshum tzaar habbehema lo ratzu ligzor al zeh, vetzarik lered mimmenna miyyad. Veken poreqin hammassoy meal gabbe habbehema, mishshum tzaar baale chayyim. Vaapillu haya hammassoy dabar shehu muqtzeh veasur betiltul — hare zeh maknis rosho tachat hammassoy umesalleqo letzad acher vehu nopel meelayv, sheen issur tiltul muqtzeh ella beyadayv, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"a. Veeno rashshay lehanniach hammassoy aleha ad lemotzae shabbat, mippene tzaar baale chayyim (veim yaggia lo hepsed im yippol hammassoy — nitbaer besimman rs"v):

Vetzarik lizzaher keshepporeq hammassoy shello yismok atzmo letzidde habbehema. (Veim b' saqqin munnachim al hachamor, echad mimino veechad missemolo, uberosh kol echad mehassaqqin retzua achat veqosherim otan shette haretzuot yachad, veakshav munnach haqqesher keneged gabbo shel hachamor vehassaqqin makbidin lekan ulekan vei epshar lehattir haqqesher im lo yagbiah hassaqqin meat, venimtza shennismakim hassaqqin al tzidde habbehema keshemmagbiah otam — asur leporqam beshabbat meal hachamor):

Behema shennopla leammat hammayim, im yakol litten lah parnasa bimqomah — meparnesin otah ad motzae shabbat. Veim hammayim amuqqim shei epshar leparnesah sham — mebi karim ukesatot umanniach tachteha, veim olta — olta. Veap al pi shemmebattel keli mehekano, shehare keshennishru hakkarim bammayim shub enan reuyim liklum bo bayyom (shei epshar leshotchan lenaggeban, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a) — lo gazeru chakamim al zeh bimqom tzaar baale chayyim, shetztzaar baale chayyim hu min hattora. Abal asur lehaalot habbehema beyado im lo olta al gabbe hakkarim, apillu im tamut sham, mippene shehi muqtzeh, velo hittiru tiltul muqtzeh ap bimqom tzaar baale chayyim, sheyyesh koach beyad chakamim laaqor dabar min hattora be"sheb veal taaseh". (Veyesh mattirin lehaalotah beyadayim mishshum tzaar baale chayyim. Veyesh lismok al datam bimqom hepsed merubbeh). Abal (ledibre hakkol) muttar lomar lenokri lehaalotah:

Veken muttar lomar lo lehamrot haavvazot paam achat bayyom, mishshum tzaar baale chayyim sheenan yekolot leekol. Veim en sham nokri — muttar leyisrael lehamrotan, ap al pi sheaseru hamraa beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"d, mishshum tzaar baale chayyim hittiru. Umikkol maqom, tob laasot al yede qatan:

Haddash hu meabot melakot, vekol hampareq okel o mashqeh mimmaqom shennitkasseh bo, kegon hacholeb et habbehema, shemmepareq hechalab mehaddad — hare zeh toledet haddash, shehaddash gam ken mepareq hattebua mehashshibbolet. Veeno chayyab ella keshecholeb letok keli reqan, abal im choleb letok keli sheyyesh bo okalin — patur, mippene shemmashqeh habba laokel hare hu keokel, venimtza sheen shem mashqeh al chalab zeh ella shem okel, vedadde habbehema hem gam ken okel, vahare zeh kemaprid okel meokel, veen bezeh mishshum mepareq. Veeno domeh ledash, shemmepareq hattebua shehi okel mehashshibbolet shehi pesolet, vehem shene debarim chaluqim zeh mizzeh, veshayyak lomar shemmepareq dabar echad mittok dabar acher hamkasseh alayv. Veken hacholeb likli reqan, shehechalab hu mashqeh umeporqo mehabbehema shehi okel, shehem shene debarim chaluqim zeh mizzeh umedubbaqin zeh bazeh, vipareq echad mittok chabero hamkasseh alayv, mah sheen ken keshehechalab hu okel — hare hu kemo dabar echad im gup habbehema shennitpareq mimmenna shehu gam ken okel, vahare zeh kenotel maakal ab vechoqeq mittokah meat okel, sheen bezeh mishshum mepareq okel mimmaqom shennitkasseh bo, mippene sheen zeh nechshab kissuy lazeh. Umikkol maqom, middibre soperim asur lachalob apillu letok haokalim, lepi shekkevan shehabbehema enah reuya laakila beshabbat mechamat issur shechita — en shem okel aleha, vahare hi kipsolet, vehampareq mittokah hechalab shehi okel — hare zeh domeh ledash, shemmepareq okel mittok happesolet. Abal beyom tob shehi reuya laakila — muttar lachalob letok haokalin, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman tq"h:

Muttar lomar lenokri lachalob habbehema beshabbat, mippene shehi mitztaeret merob hechalab, velo gazeru al amira lenokri bimqom tzaar baale chayyim shehu min hattora. Umikkol maqom, tzarik sheyyittol hannokri et hechalab leatzmo, o yachazor veyiqneh hechalab mehannokri bedabar muat, kede shello yehe nireh kecholeb letzorek yisrael ella letzorek atzmo, shello hittiru ella haamira mishshum tzaar baale chayyim, abal lo sheyyaaseh bishbil yisrael ella bishbil atzmo, shekkesheoseh bishbil yisrael hare hu shelucho mammash, vahare zeh keillu asa hayyisrael beatzmo, sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto. Veap sheen omerim ken ella beyisrael shennaaseh shaliach leyisrael, mikkol maqom chakamim hechemiru ken gabbe shabbat veyom tob vekayyotze bahen ap benokri shennaaseh shaliach leyisrael sheyyehe nechshab kemoto mammash kesheoseh bishbilo. Abal kesheoseh bishbil atzmo — lo hechemiru ella shello lomar lo laasot, veal derek sheyyitbaer besop simman sh"z, vekan hittiru mishshum tzaar baale chayyim:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheamar lehannokri lachalob, abal im nokri chalab meatzmo — muttar littol mimmennu hechalab bechinnam, veen tzarik liqnoto mimmennu apillu bedabar muat (mippene shekkol nokri haoseh meatzmo bevadday mitkavven letobato sheyyeqabbel tobat hanaa mehayyisrael bishbil zeh, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"b, vahare zeh kecholeb leatzmo):

Vekol zeh benokri sheeno abdo, abal abdo veshipchato hassekurim lo leshana o lishnatayim — en tzarik liqnot mehem hechalab ap im amar lahem lachalob beshabbat, mippene shehem mitkavvenim bimlaktam letobatam, kede sheyyeqabbelu kol sekaram besop shenatam, shekkeshenniskeru battechilla ledaat ken niskeru, sheyyachlebu bekol et shetztzarik lachalob:

Vekol zeh leekol hechalab lemotzae shabbat, abal beshabbat atzmah asur apillu letaltelo, apillu chalabah hannokri meatzmo, vaapillu hi behemat hannokri, mippene sheggazeru chakamim al mashqim shezzabu mehapperot beshabbat mealehem o al yede nokri leosram ad lemotzae shabbat, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman sh"k veshak"h, ubiklal gezera zo hu gam ken hechalab shennechlab beshabbat shehu gam ken mashqeh hannolad beshabbat, vekevan sheasur baakila — asur gam ken betiltul, shemmuqtzeh hu, kevan sheeno rauy lebo bayyom. Veap im chalabah letok haokalin sheen al hechalab torat mashqeh veeno biklal gezerat mashqin shezzabu — ap al pi ken asur ad haereb, im lo nechlab miyyad biknisat hashshabbat ella leachar zeman beinyan sheepshar sherob hechalab shebbedad hu nolad sham beshabbat, sheoto hechalab shennittosep bah beshabbat hu muqtzeh, mippene shehu maaseh chadash shennolad beshabbat, sheddam nekar venaaseh chalab. Veap shehaya dato alayv mibbeod yom — en zeh moil kelum, kevan shello haya az adayin baolam. Veeno domeh lishar nolad beshabbat shemmuttar, mippene shehaya kebar baolam mibbeod yom ella shennishtanna beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"ch. Umah shehittiru beyom tob lachalob letok haokalin, hu mippene shekkevan shehabbehema reuya laakila beyom tob im hechalab shebbah, sheim haya rotzeh haya shochatah veokel gam hechalab shennittosep bah beyom tob, mippene shehu tapel eleha ubatel etzlah, im ken gam keshennechlab mimmenna bechayyeha — eno asur mishshum nolad, mippene shehu keokel hanniprad meokel, shehu im gup habbehema hem kemo dabar echad, sheshshenehem torat okel alehem, vahare zeh okel shenniprad meokel, veen torat nolad alayv ap al pi shehu maaseh chadash, mah sheen ken beshabbat sheen habbehema reuya laakila — hare hechalab shennechlab mimmenna niqra nolad gamur, shennolad baolam beshabbat:

Haggebinot sheosot hashshepachot beshabbat mechalab shel yisrael, im osot bebet yisrael, ap al pi sheosot meatzman shello middaat hayyisrael, shebbevadday mitkavvenot letobat atzman limtzo chen beene hayyisrael kemo shennitbaer besimman d"sh — ap al pi ken tzarik limchot beyadan, mippene marit haayin, sheyyomru shelledato hen osot, kevan sheosot bebeto, ukemo shennitbaer besimman rn"b. Veod, shekkevan sheosot mechalab shello vehu roeh veshoteq lahen — hen mebinot shehu chapetz bekak uledato hen osot, kemo shennitbaer sham:

Mi sheyyesh lo naar nokri verokeb al habbehema keshemmolikah lehashqotah — eno tzarik lemono, mippene shehachay nose et atzmo, veen issur ap leadam lehotzi et hachay lirshut harabbim ella middibre soperim, ubibhemto lo gazeru. Abal tzarik lemono shello yitten aleha begadayv sheppeshatam mealayv velo shum dabar:

Muttar limsor sus o chamor leroeh nokri, veen chosheshim sheyyaaseh bahem melaka beshabbat, mippene shemmityare shello yehe nitpas kegannab im yishtammesh bahem. Veeno domeh lemashil behemto lenokri laasot bah melaka bechol umatneh immo shettanuach beshabbat, veap al pi ken asur mippene sheen hannokri neeman al kak kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"v, lepi sheshsham eno nitpas kegannab im yaaseh bah gam beshabbat, kevan shehashshabbat hi betok meshek zeman sheelato shehi mesura lo limlaka, mah sheen ken haroeh sheen habbehema mesura lo kelal limlaka ap bechol ella lirotah bilbad — hare hu nitpas kegannab im yishtammesh bah. Veim roeh oto o noda lo sheoseh bah melaka beshabbat — chayyab limchot beyado:

Mi sheqqonta behemto shebita beben hashshemashot etzel haroeh hashshobet chutz litchum hair, ubeshabbat yotza mittechum haroeh litchum shello — asur lehabi beyado lebeto, mippene sheen lah sham ella d' ammot, kedin adam hayyotze chutz lattechum sheqqana bo shebita ben hashshemashot, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shtz"v. Abal muttar lo liqrotah shettabo acharayv ad beto, kevan sheeno molikah beyadayim ella hi holeket meatzmah al yede qeriato, veenennu muzhar lemonah mizzeh, sheen adam muzhar al issure techume behemto, kemo sheyyitbaer. Vaapillu im yatzata chutz litchum shello vechutz litchum shellah — yakol liqrotah shettabo etzlo, veen chosheshim im nattir lo zeh shemma yabo lelek etzlah chutz lattechum kede lahabiah lebeto, mippene sheen bahul al behemto kol kak laasot issur bishbilah, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"b:

Muttar limsor behema leroeh apillu beshabbat, ap al pi shebbeben hashshemashot qonta habbehema shebita etzel hayyisrael balah alpayim lekol ruach ubeshabbat yolikenna haroeh lirot chutz lattechum — en bekak kelum, sheen adam muzhar al techum behemto. Vaapillu im yolikenna chutz ley"b mil sheyyesh omerim shettechum zeh min hattora, mikkol maqom eno niqra beshem asiyyat melaka, ella hu issur bipne atzmo, veen adam metzuvveh ella shettishbot behemto measiyyat melaka, velo mehalika chutz lattechum. Velo qonta habbehema shebita etzlo ella leinyan sheasur lekol adam leholikah beyadayim chutz litchum shellah apillu mi sheyyakol lelek sham beatzmo, kegon shehinniach erube techumin sham, abal mah shehannokri molikah chutz lattechum meatzmo belo amirat hayyisrael, ap al pi shehayyisrael mesarah lo — en zeh chamur mimmah shehu qore lah vehi baa acharayv shehittiru chakamim. Veyesh mi sheoser lemosrah lo beshabbat apillu im yadua shello yolikenna chutz ley"b mil ella chutz lealpayim. Vetob lachush lidbarayv. Ubemaqom shennahagu lehachamir shello limsor ap beyom v', im nahagu ken kede laasot seyag vegader — en lehattir lahem. Veim nahagu ken mechamat taut shehayu seburim sheyyesh issur baddabar — mattirim bipnehem, umodiim lahem shehu muttar gamur. Veap im haroeh molik habbehema mibbet hayyisrael beshabbat atzmah kevan shemmesarah lo meereb shabbat — lo qonta shebita kelal etzel hayyisrael, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shtz"z. Veap sheqqonta shebita keragle haroeh hannokri, mikkol maqom kevan shecheptze nokri en qonin shebita ella mishshum sheggazeru al bealim nokrim mishshum bealim yisrael, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"a — en lehachamir kol kak ligzor ap keshehannokri molikah chutz lattechum meatzmo ap shehayyisrael moserah lo, kevan sherabbim mattirim bekol inyan:
